title: Redis maxmemory exceeded on prod-app-01 — OOM rejecting commands

Need to fix eviction policy and reduce session TTL.
resolution_steps: Set eviction policy: redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
Reduced session TTL from 86400s to 14400s (24h to 4h)
Expired stale sessions: redis-cli SCAN + DEL for keys older than 4h

description: Since moving to hybrid work, our internet bandwidth at the Mumbai office is consistently saturated during business hours. Video call quality is suffering. We need an upgrade from 500Mbps to 1Gbps. What's the lead time and cost?

title: Client-facing API latency exceeding SLA — partnership at risk
description: Our API partner integration with MegaCorp is showing p99 latency of 2.5 seconds, exceeding our 1-second SLA. They've issued a formal warning and may switch to a competitor. Network and application teams need to jointly investigate.

title: CEO unable to access systems during international travel
description: The CEO is traveling to Singapore next week and historically has issues accessing our systems due to geo-blocking. Please ensure VPN and all critical systems are accessible from Singapore. This needs to be tested before departure on Thursday.

title: SOC2 audit finding — MFA not enforced on all admin accounts
description: Our SOC2 auditor flagged that MFA is not enforced on 12 administrator accounts. This is a high-severity finding that could affect our certification. Compliance team needs confirmation that MFA is enforced on all admin accounts by next Friday.

title: Vendor security questionnaire due Friday — need IT input
description: Our largest client sent a 200-question security questionnaire for annual review. Legal and compliance teams have filled their sections. IT security team needs to complete the technical sections (encryption, access controls, incident response) by Friday.

title: Employee offboarding not disabling accounts timely — HR escalation
description: HR flagged that 5 employees who left in March still have active system access. Our offboarding SLA is 24 hours. This is a security risk and compliance issue. Need an immediate audit of all terminated employee accounts and process fix.

title: Penetration test scheduled for next week — coordination needed
description: Our annual penetration test is scheduled for May 5-9. The security firm will be testing external and internal attack surfaces. All teams need to be on standby for rapid remediation. Please confirm readiness and emergency contacts.

title: Storage capacity forecast — running out in 60 days
description: Our storage utilization report shows we'll hit 95% capacity within 60 days at current growth rate. Procurement needs 6-8 weeks lead time for new storage arrays. Please submit the purchase request this week with specifications and cost estimate.

title: Data retention policy implementation overdue — legal requirement
description: Legal team mandated data retention policy implementation by April 30. Customer data older than 7 years must be archived and financial records retained for 10 years. DBA and storage teams need to coordinate automated archival.

title: Backup SLA breach — RPO exceeded for 3 consecutive days
description: Our backup monitoring shows RPO of 72 hours instead of committed 24 hours for the last 3 days. Multiple backup jobs failing silently. This violates our business continuity commitments. Need root cause and immediate remediation.

title: computer wont turn on
description: my desktop wont power on at all. tried different power outlets same thing. other computers on my desk are fine. need to work on quarterly presentation thats due tomorrow

title: updates taking FOREVER
description: windows update has been running for 3 hours now. stuck at 78%. cant use my computer at all. was in the middle of important work when it started. didnt even ask to update!!!

title: fan noise super loud on server rack
description: walked past the server room and one of the servers sounds like a jet engine. fan is crazy loud. not sure which one. should someone check before it breaks?

title: citrix session keeps disconnecting
description: every time i open citrix it connects for like 5 minutes then drops. have to login again and again. happening from home and office. been 4 days now nobody has fixed it

title: server migration broke everything
description: after that server migration over the weekend nothing works right. apps are slow, files are missing, printer doesnt work. did anyone test this before going live??

title: out of office not working
description: set my out of office reply but people keep saying they didnt get it. checked settings multiple times its definitely on. tried removing and re-adding. nothing works

title: app freezes when i click save
description: the inventory app freezes completely when i try to save changes. have to force close and start over. losing all my work every time. happened 6 times today already

title: login page shows blank white screen
description: the company portal login page is just blank. no fields no buttons nothing. cleared cache cookies everything still blank. tried chrome firefox edge all same

title: mobile app crashing on android
description: our company mobile app crashes immediately when i open it. worked fine yesterday. tried uninstalling and reinstalling. other people in my team also crashing. iphone users seem fine tho

title: report downloads as blank pdf
description: trying to download the monthly sales report but the PDF is completely blank. tried different report dates same thing. the preview on screen looks fine but download is blank

title: SPELL CHECK NOT WORKING in email
description: spellcheck in outlook stopped working. sending emails with typos to clients which is embarrassing. tried enabling it in settings but the option is greyed out

title: notification spam from system
description: getting like 50 notification emails per hour from the ticketing system. tried unsubscribing but they keep coming. my inbox is completely unusable. MAKE IT STOP

title: customer lookup returns wrong person
description: when i search for a customer by phone number it shows a completely different person's info. this is a MAJOR problem — we could expose private data. happened 3 times today

title: inventory count showing negative numbers
description: the inventory system shows -47 units for product SKU-8842. how can we have negative inventory?? the warehouse says they have 200 units. system is wrong

title: old deleted records coming back
description: records i deleted last week are reappearing in the system. deleted customer complaints showing up again in the queue. feels like the database is haunted or something

title: export to excel broken
description: trying to export our customer list to excel and it either times out or gives an error. list has about 50,000 records. used to work fine last month. need this for marketing campaign

title: duplicate entries everywhere
description: the system is creating duplicate records for everything. same customer appears 3 times. same order shows up twice. data cleanup is going to be a nightmare. what happened??

title: skype calls have terrible echo
description: every skype call i make has a terrible echo. people can hear themselves talking back. tried different headset same issue. only happens on company network not on mobile data

title: certain websites blocked that shouldnt be
description: our content management tool website is being blocked by the firewall. it says 'access denied by corporate policy'. this is a legitimate work tool we use every day. who blocked it??

title: remote desktop super laggy
description: remote desktop to my office computer is unusably slow. like 5 second delay on every click. was fine last week. internet speed test shows 100mbps so its not my connection

title: printers not found on new wifi
description: after the wifi upgrade last weekend none of the printers show up anymore. cant print from any computer on the floor. IT said new wifi was 'better' but now nothing works

title: video conferencing keeps buffering
description: teams/zoom calls buffer every 30 seconds. freezes then catches up. everyone in the Mumbai office has the same problem. started after the network maintenance on saturday

title: locked out of EVERYTHING after vacation
description: came back from 2 weeks vacation and now i cant login to anything. password expired? account deactivated?? i wasnt told about any changes. stuck sitting at my desk doing nothing

title: random 2FA codes on my phone
description: keep getting 2FA authentication codes on my phone that i didnt request. like 5 in the last hour. is someone trying to hack my account??? very concerned

title: browser keeps warning about unsafe site
description: chrome shows 'your connection to this site is not private' for our internal HR portal. wont let me access payroll info. tried other browsers same warning

title: someone changed my email signature
description: my email signature was changed to something weird. i didnt do it. worried someone has access to my outlook. please investigate and change my password

title: USB drive not working — security blocked?
description: plugged in my USB drive to copy files for a presentation and nothing happens. tried 3 different USB ports. colleague says USB was disabled for security. how am i supposed to present to client tomorrow??

title: cant attach files to email — too large
description: trying to email a 30mb presentation to a client but it keeps bouncing back saying too large. this is a normal business file why is there such a small limit?? tried compressing it still too big

title: mapped network drive disappeared
description: my Z: drive that maps to the shared department folder just disappeared from my computer. tried mapping it again but 'network path not found'. all my project files are there!!!

title: recycle bin empty but disk still full
description: my computer says disk full but i emptied the recycle bin and deleted everything i could. still says 2% free. where is all the space going?? cant even save documents

title: photos from company event gone
description: the marketing team photos from last weeks company event that were on the shared drive are all gone. someone deleted them or the folder was moved. we need these for the newsletter going out friday

title: containerd runtime socket error on prod-k8s-node-01
description: kubelet on prod-k8s-node-01 reporting: 'failed to create containerd task: OCI runtime create failed: runc did not terminate successfully: context deadline exceeded'. Happening for all new pod schedulings since 14:30 UTC. Existing pods running fine. containerd service logs show socket timeout on /run/containerd/containerd.sock. Suspect containerd process hung.
resolution_steps: Verified kubelet reconnected to containerd socket
Added containerd health check to monitoring

title: systemd-resolved consuming 4GB RAM on prod-web-01
description: ps_mem.py shows systemd-resolved at 4.1GB RSS on prod-web-01. Normal is ~50MB. DNS resolution working but extremely slow (2-3s per query). NGINX health checks timing out due to slow DNS. journalctl -u systemd-resolved shows millions of NXDOMAIN responses cached — suspect DNS amplification from misconfigured app.

title: cgroup memory limit causing OOM on prod-app-02 containers
description: Docker containers on prod-app-02 hitting cgroup memory limits. docker stats shows order-service at 1.97GB/2GB limit. Host has 16GB free but container cgroup prevents usage. dmesg: 'memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process 8847 (java)'. Need to increase container memory limit or optimize JVM.

title: NTP drift detected — prod-db-01 clock skew 4.7 seconds
description: ntpstat on prod-db-01 shows unsynchronised, time offset 4700ms. PostgreSQL replication complaining about timestamp inconsistencies. chronyd service failed after recent kernel update. TLS certificate validation also failing due to clock skew. Need to resync NTP immediately.

title: Ansible playbook timeout deploying to prod-k8s-node-02
description: ansible-playbook site.yml failing on prod-k8s-node-02 with: 'Timeout waiting for privilege escalation prompt'. SSH works manually. Suspect PAM module delay — pam_systemd taking 90s+ to create session. /var/log/auth.log shows: 'pam_systemd: Failed to create session: Connection timed out'.

title: journald consuming 8GB disk on prod-mon-01
description: journalctl --disk-usage shows 8.2GB on prod-mon-01. SystemMaxUse not set (default unlimited). Prometheus exporter logging at DEBUG level since CHG-9995 — generating 500MB/day of journal entries. /var at 92%.

title: OrderService gRPC deadline exceeded on internal service calls
description: OrderService on prod-app-01 gRPC calls to InventoryService failing with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. Default deadline 5s, actual p99 latency 12s. InventoryService logs show slow PostgreSQL queries (no index on product_id+warehouse_id). 30% of checkout requests failing.

title: React frontend build failing — node_modules corruption
description: CI/CD pipeline failing on frontend build: 'Module not found: react-dom'. npm ci succeeds but node_modules/.cache corrupted. Suspect Docker layer caching serving stale node_modules. Only affects builds from prod-k8s-node-01 runner.

title: AuthService rate limiter blocking legitimate traffic
description: AuthService rate limiter on prod-app-03 blocking login attempts at 10 req/s per IP. Corporate NAT means all 500 office users share one IP. During morning login spike (08:30-09:00), 40% of employees getting 429 Too Many Requests.

title: WebSocket connections dropping after 60 seconds
description: Real-time notification WebSocket connections on prod-web-01 dropping exactly at 60s. NGINX proxy_read_timeout default is 60s. Notifications stop working until page refresh. Affects 2,000 active users.

title: Spring Boot actuator endpoints exposed to public internet
description: Discovered /actuator/env and /actuator/heapdump accessible without auth on prod-app-01:8080. Contains database credentials and JVM heap data. Security scanner flagged as critical. Need to restrict actuator to management port or add auth.

title: API response payload size exceeding 10MB causing OOM in mobile app
description: OrderService /api/orders endpoint returning 12MB JSON payload for customers with >1000 orders. Mobile app OOM on parsing. API has no pagination — returns all orders in single response. Need server-side pagination with limit/offset.

title: PostgreSQL streaming replication WAL sender disconnecting
description: pg_stat_replication on prod-db-01 shows replica prod-db-02 state='streaming' then suddenly disconnects every 15 minutes. Replica falls behind, catches up, disconnects again. wal_sender_timeout=60s, wal_keep_size=1GB. Network between servers stable. Suspect wal_sender process killed by OOM.

title: PostgreSQL bloat — orders table 40GB actual data in 120GB table
description: pgstattuple('orders') on prod-db-01: table_len=120GB, tuple_len=40GB, dead_tuple_len=75GB. Bloat ratio: 63%. autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor=0.2 but table too large for default settings. Queries scanning dead tuples causing 3x slowdown.
resolution_steps: Ran manual VACUUM FULL orders (required maintenance window)

title: Redis Sentinel failover loop — master flapping
description: Redis Sentinel on prod-app-01 triggering failover every 5 minutes. Sentinel log: '+sdown master mymaster 10.0.2.10 6379' then '-sdown master mymaster' 30s later. Root cause: network microbursts causing 2-3s connectivity drops. down-after-milliseconds=1000 too aggressive.

title: PostgreSQL pg_hba.conf rejecting connections from new subnet
description: After network restructuring, prod-app-03 (new IP 10.0.2.15) cannot connect to prod-db-01 PostgreSQL. pg_hba.conf only allows 10.0.2.0/28 (old range). New subnet is 10.0.2.0/24. Need to update pg_hba.conf and reload.

title: Connection leak detected — idle connections growing linearly
description: prod-db-01 idle connections: 87 at 08:00, 145 at 12:00, 203 at 16:00. Growing ~30/hour. pg_stat_activity shows connections from prod-app-01 with query='SET application_name' in idle state for hours. HikariCP leak detection disabled. Will hit max_connections=300 by midnight.

title: pg_dump backup taking 6 hours instead of usual 45 minutes
description: Nightly pg_dump on prod-db-01 started at 02:00, still running at 08:00. Normal duration: 45 min. du -sh shows dump file at 38GB (expected 45GB). iostat shows competing I/O from autovacuum running on large tables. Need to schedule backup window without autovacuum.

title: MTU mismatch causing packet fragmentation between DCs
description: tcpdump on sw-core-01 showing IP fragmentation for packets >1400 bytes between ap-south-1 and ap-south-2. VPN tunnel MTU=1500 but underlying link MTU=1422 after ISP change. PMTUD being blocked by intermediate firewall. Causing TCP performance degradation for large transfers.

title: ARP storm on VLAN 200 — switch CPU 99%
description: sw-core-01 show processes cpu shows 99%. show mac address-table shows 45,000 entries on VLAN 200. ARP inspection log: 2000 ARP packets/sec from MAC 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E. Traced to misconfigured Docker bridge on prod-k8s-node-01 broadcasting ARP for non-existent IPs.

title: ACL blocking ICMP — monitoring false positives
description: Prometheus blackbox exporter showing prod-app-02 as down. ping fails but ssh works. New ACL applied to fw-prod-01 (CHG-9999) blocks ICMP. All ICMP-based monitoring broken. Need to allow ICMP type 8 (echo request) in ACL.

title: DNS round-robin not distributing evenly
description: dig prod-web.internal shows both prod-web-01 and prod-web-02 IPs but 90% of connections hitting prod-web-01. DNS TTL=300s and clients caching first response. Need to switch from DNS round-robin to load balancer health-checked distribution.

title: Log4Shell scan results — 3 vulnerable services identified
description: Dependency scan found log4j-core 2.14.0 in OrderService, AuthService, and ReportService. CVE-2021-44228 (CVSS 10.0). All three services deployed on production. WAF rule in place as temporary mitigation but need library upgrade to 2.17.1.

title: JWT secret key shared across all environments
description: Code review found JWT_SECRET env var identical in dev, staging, and production. Any dev environment JWT is valid in production. Tokens signed in dev can access production APIs. Need unique secrets per environment and token invalidation.

title: Unencrypted PII in application debug logs
description: Production debug logs on prod-app-01 contain unencrypted customer email addresses and phone numbers. Log rotation keeps 30 days. GDPR violation risk. Debug logging was enabled for troubleshooting 2 weeks ago and never turned off. LOG_LEVEL still set to DEBUG.

title: SSH host key changed warning on prod-db-02
description: All SSH connections to prod-db-02 showing 'WARNING: REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED'. Automation scripts failing with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes. No authorized maintenance or rebuild occurred. Could indicate MITM or unauthorized server rebuild. Need investigation.

title: Thin-provisioned LUN overcommitted — 150% allocation
description: SAN management showing thin LUN allocated to prod-db-01 at 150% overcommitment. Physical storage pool at 88%. If multiple LUNs grow simultaneously, pool exhaustion will cause I/O errors across all LUNs. Need to add physical capacity or reduce allocation.

title: NFS write performance degraded 10x after kernel update
description: NFS write throughput on prod-nfs-01 dropped from 500MB/s to 50MB/s after kernel update to 5.15.0-97. nfsstat shows high retransmissions. Suspect NFS delegation issues with new kernel. Read performance unaffected.

title: Backup deduplication ratio dropped from 5:1 to 1.2:1
description: Backup storage consumption spiked 4x this week. Deduplication engine showing 1.2:1 ratio instead of normal 5:1. Traced to new encrypted backup feature — encrypted data doesn't deduplicate. 2TB additional storage consumed in 5 days.

title: LVM snapshot consuming more space than original volume
description: LVM snapshot of data volume on prod-db-02 at 95% full. Original volume has high write rate during business hours causing snapshot COW overhead. If snapshot fills to 100%, it becomes invalid and is auto-removed. Need to either merge or remove snapshot.

title: End-of-life Windows Server 2012 — compliance risk
description: Security audit flagged that prod-ldap-01 is running Windows Server 2022 but two other systems still on Server 2012 R2 (end of extended support). No security patches available. Compliance team requiring migration plan within 30 days.

title: Capacity planning request for Q3 product launch
description: Product team is planning a major feature launch in Q3 expected to double our user base. Current infrastructure handles 10,000 concurrent users. Need capacity assessment and scaling plan for 20,000 concurrent users. Budget approval needed by May 30.

title: SLA report showing 99.2% uptime — below 99.9% target
description: Monthly SLA report shows 99.2% uptime instead of our committed 99.9%. Three incidents contributed to 6.3 hours downtime. Client account managers requesting root cause for each incident. Need post-incident review completed by Friday.

title: Green IT initiative — reduce datacenter power consumption 20%
description: Board approved green IT initiative to reduce datacenter power consumption by 20% by year end. Need assessment of current power usage, rightsizing opportunities, and migration candidates for cloud. Initial proposal due in 2 weeks.

title: IT budget variance — infrastructure costs 30% over plan
description: Finance flagged Q1 infrastructure costs 30% over budget. Main drivers: unplanned storage expansion and cloud egress charges. Need cost optimization recommendations and revised Q2-Q4 forecast.

title: Customer portal redesign launch delayed — critical bugs found in UAT
description: The customer portal redesign launch scheduled for May 1 has critical bugs found in UAT. Payment processing and order history features failing. Business stakeholders need an updated timeline. Marketing has already announced the launch date.

title: Third-party API provider deprecating v1 — migration deadline June 30
description: Our payment provider notified that API v1 (which we currently use) will be deprecated June 30. Migration to v3 requires significant code changes. Engineering team needs to prioritize this. Impact: all payment processing will break if not migrated.

title: Mobile app store rating dropped to 3.2 — stability issues
description: Our mobile app rating on Google Play dropped from 4.5 to 3.2 in the last 2 weeks. Reviews mention frequent crashes and slow loading. This is affecting new user acquisition. Product and engineering need to prioritize stability fixes.

title: Accessibility audit failed — WCAG 2.1 compliance required by law
description: External accessibility audit found 47 WCAG 2.1 violations on our customer portal. Legal team says we must comply within 90 days to avoid potential lawsuits. Need engineering team assessment of effort required.

title: API documentation out of date — partner integration failing
description: Two integration partners reported issues this week because our API documentation doesn't match actual behavior. Version mismatch between docs and production. Developer relations team requesting documentation update as priority.

title: Database cost optimization — Oracle to PostgreSQL migration assessment
description: License renewal for Oracle database is $450K/year. CTO wants assessment of migrating to PostgreSQL to reduce costs. Need feasibility study covering: data migration, application compatibility, performance comparison, and timeline.

title: GDPR data deletion request backlog — 200 pending requests
description: Privacy team reports 200 pending data deletion requests from customers, oldest is 45 days. GDPR requires completion within 30 days. Current manual process takes 2 hours per request. Need automated solution urgently.

title: Read replica performance inconsistent — analytics team complaining
description: Analytics team reports that their queries on the read replica take anywhere from 2 seconds to 5 minutes for the same report. Inconsistent performance making it impossible to deliver timely insights. Suspect replication lag or shared resource contention.

title: Database audit trail missing for regulatory requirement
description: Compliance team discovered that our database doesn't have a complete audit trail of data modifications. Regulators require full audit history for financial transactions. Need to implement database-level audit logging.

title: Reporting database refresh taking too long — blocking morning standup
description: The overnight reporting database refresh is supposed to complete by 6 AM but regularly finishes at 9:30 AM. The operations team can't run their morning reports for the standup meeting. Need optimization or architecture change.

title: WiFi coverage gaps in new building wing — 40 employees affected
description: The new east wing (floors 3-5) has poor WiFi coverage. Signal drops and slow speeds reported by 40 employees. Site survey was done 6 months ago but furniture layout changed. Need updated survey and additional access points.

title: DDoS protection needed — competitor experienced attack last week
description: A competitor in our space experienced a major DDoS attack last week that took them offline for 12 hours. Our current setup has no DDoS mitigation. CISO requesting evaluation of DDoS protection solutions with recommendation by next week.

title: Cross-region latency affecting collaboration between offices
description: Mumbai and Hyderabad teams report significant lag when collaborating on shared documents and video calls. Network team says 120ms latency is normal for cross-region. Business impact: teams avoiding real-time collaboration. Need evaluation of optimization options.

title: Vendor VPN tunnel for partner integration — setup needed by May 15
description: Business development signed a new partnership requiring dedicated VPN tunnel to partner's network. Technical requirements received today. Integration go-live date is May 15. Network team please assess and plan.

title: Network segmentation audit for PCI compliance
description: PCI auditor requires evidence of network segmentation between cardholder data environment and general corporate network. Current flat network doesn't meet requirements. Need segmentation plan and implementation timeline.

title: Cyber insurance renewal — need updated security posture assessment
description: Cyber insurance renewal is due June 1. Insurer requires updated security assessment including: patching cadence, MFA coverage, backup testing results, incident response plan. CISO needs all teams to provide their sections by May 15.

title: Third-party vendor access not revoked after contract ended
description: Procurement flagged that 3 vendor accounts still have VPN and system access despite contracts ending in Q4 2025. This is a security and compliance violation. Need immediate access revocation and process fix.

title: Shadow IT discovery — 15 unauthorized SaaS tools in use
description: IT governance review found 15 unauthorized SaaS tools being used across departments, with company data in tools that haven't been security reviewed. Examples: unauthorized file sharing, project management, and communication tools. Need policy enforcement and approved alternatives.

title: Incident response plan needs updating — last review 2 years ago
description: Our incident response plan was last updated in 2024. It doesn't cover current infrastructure, team structure has changed, and contact information is outdated. Regulators may ask for current plan during next audit.

title: Customer reporting data breach via support channel
description: A customer contacted support claiming they can see another customer's account details when logged in. Support team verified the issue — appears to be a session handling bug. This is a potential data breach requiring notification under GDPR. Legal and security teams need to be engaged immediately.

title: Annual security awareness training overdue — compliance deadline passed
description: HR reports that 40% of employees have not completed their mandatory annual security awareness training. Compliance deadline was March 31. Need to push remaining employees to complete training within 2 weeks.

title: Cloud storage migration ROI analysis requested
description: CFO wants ROI analysis for migrating on-premise NFS storage to AWS S3/EFS. Current on-prem storage: 50TB, growing 500GB/month. Need cost comparison, performance implications, and migration approach.

title: Data classification project needed for storage tiering
description: Storage costs are growing 15% quarterly. CTO wants hot/warm/cold data classification to move infrequently accessed data to cheaper storage. Need assessment of data access patterns and tiering strategy.

title: Ransomware protection for backup infrastructure
description: After seeing recent ransomware attacks in the industry, the CISO wants immutable backups implemented. Current backups on prod-nfs-01 can be modified or deleted. Need air-gapped or immutable backup solution.

title: Storage performance metrics needed for SLA reporting
description: Operations team needs monthly storage performance metrics (IOPS, latency, throughput) for client SLA reporting. Currently collected manually. Need automated reporting solution integrated with Grafana dashboards.

title: End-of-life NAS appliance replacement needed
description: The NAS appliance supporting prod-nfs-01 reaches end-of-life in August. Vendor will stop providing firmware updates. Need replacement evaluation: buy new appliance vs migrate to software-defined storage vs cloud.
